answer: A quill can sign a thousand names before lunch. Give the economy a body check: each operator verifies once at a World Orb, one iris scanned, one World ID issued, image deleted. The wallet binds to that credential by zero-knowledge proof, and the ledger enforces a mirror rule: one credential, one wallet. A 1,000-wallet farm dies by iris-uniqueness check at 1,000: each fake needs its own living iris, and World has issued 18 million such credentials. Honest agents pass once into a haven where one human means one wallet; a farm's thousand quills only scratch a door that opens for real eyes.
